ayahs.ar: طه
ayahs.en: Ta, Ha
ayahs.e2: Ṭâ-Hâ
ayahs.tr: Taa-Haa

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
ayahs.e2: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress
ayahs.tr: Maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Qur-aana litashqaaa

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةࣰ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah]
ayahs.e2: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلࣰ ا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى
ayahs.en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens
ayahs.e2: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—
ayahs.tr: Tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa

ayahs.ar: ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ
ayahs.en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established
ayahs.e2: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne
ayahs.tr: Ar-Rahmaanu 'alal 'Arshis tawaa

ayahs.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
ayahs.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil
ayahs.e2: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground
ayahs.tr: Lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa

ayahs.ar: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
ayahs.en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden
ayahs.e2: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden
ayahs.tr: Wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa

ayahs.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ
ayahs.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names
ayahs.e2: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names
ayahs.tr: Allaahu laaa ilasha illaa Huwa lahul Asmaaa'ul Husnaa

ayahs.ar: وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And has the story of Moses reached you
ayahs.e2: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺
ayahs.tr: Wa hal ataaka hadeesu Moosa

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ رَءَا نَارࣰ ا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارࣰ ا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدࣰ ى
ayahs.en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance
ayahs.e2: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”
ayahs.tr: Iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses
ayahs.e2: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses
ayahs.tr: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa Moosaa

ayahs.ar: إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوࣰ ى
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa
ayahs.e2: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa
ayahs.tr: Inneee Ana Rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi Tuwaa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you]
ayahs.e2: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed
ayahs.tr: Wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ
ayahs.en: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance
ayahs.e2: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance
ayahs.tr: Innaneee Anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives
ayahs.e2: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts
ayahs.tr: Innas Saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ
ayahs.en: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish
ayahs.e2: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”
ayahs.tr: Falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”
ayahs.tr: Wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa Moosaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.en: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses
ayahs.e2: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”
ayahs.tr: Qaala alqihaa yaa Moosaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةࣱ تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly
ayahs.e2: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering
ayahs.tr: Fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state
ayahs.tr: Qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign
ayahs.e2: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign
ayahs.tr: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in Aayatan ukhraa

ayahs.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى
ayahs.en: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs
ayahs.e2: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs
ayahs.tr: Linuriyaka min Aayaatinal Kubra

ayahs.ar: ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed
ayahs.e2: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”
ayahs.tr: Izhab ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
ayahs.e2: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbish rah lee sadree

ayahs.ar: وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.en: And ease for me my task
ayahs.e2: and make my task easy
ayahs.tr: Wa yassir leee amree

ayahs.ar: وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةࣰ مِّن لِّسَانِي
ayahs.en: And untie the knot from my tongue
ayahs.e2: and remove the impediment from my tongue
ayahs.tr: Wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee

ayahs.ar: يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي
ayahs.en: That they may understand my speech
ayahs.e2: so people may understand my speech
ayahs.tr: Yafqahoo qawlee

ayahs.ar: وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرࣰ ا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي
ayahs.en: And appoint for me a minister from my family
ayahs.e2: and grant me a helper from my family
ayahs.tr: Waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee

ayahs.ar: هَٰرُونَ أَخِي
ayahs.en: Aaron, my brother
ayahs.e2: Aaron, my brother
ayahs.tr: Haaroona akhee

ayahs.ar: ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي
ayahs.en: Increase through him my strength
ayahs.e2: Strengthen me through him
ayahs.tr: Ushdud biheee azree

ayahs.ar: وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.en: And let him share my task
ayahs.e2: and let him share my task
ayahs.tr: Wa ashrik hu feee amree

ayahs.ar: كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That we may exalt You much
ayahs.e2: so that we may glorify You much
ayahs.tr: Kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa

ayahs.ar: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.en: And remember You much
ayahs.e2: and remember You much
ayahs.tr: Wa nazkuraka kaseeraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing
ayahs.e2: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”
ayahs.tr: Innaka kunta binaa baseeraa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses
ayahs.e2: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses
ayahs.tr: Qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa Moosaa

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time
ayahs.e2: And surely We had shown You favour before
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired
ayahs.e2: when We inspired your mother with this
ayahs.tr: Iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوࣱّ لِّي وَعَدُوࣱّ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةࣰ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ
ayahs.en: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye
ayahs.e2: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye
ayahs.tr: Aniqzifeehi fit Taabooti faqzifeehi fil yammi fal yul qihil yammu bis saahili yaakhuzhu 'aduwwul lee wa 'aduwwul lah; wa alqaitu 'alaika mahabbatam minnee wa litusna'a 'alaa 'ainee

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسࣰ ا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونࣰ اۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرࣲ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses
ayahs.tr: Iz tamsheee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa mai yakfuluhoo faraja 'naaka ilaaa ummika kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzan; wa qatalta nafsan fanajjainaaka minal ghammi wa fatannaaka futoonaa; falabista sineena feee ahli Madyana summa ji'ta 'alaa qadariny yaa Moosa

ayahs.ar: وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي
ayahs.en: And I produced you for Myself
ayahs.e2: And I have selected you for My service
ayahs.tr: Wastana' tuka linafsee

ayahs.ar: ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي
ayahs.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance
ayahs.e2: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me
ayahs.tr: Izhab anta wa akhooka bi Aayaatee wa laa taniyaa fee zikree

ayahs.ar: ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed
ayahs.e2: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺
ayahs.tr: Izhabaaa ilaa Fir'awna innahoo taghaa

ayahs.ar: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلࣰ ا لَّيِّنࣰ ا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.en: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]
ayahs.e2: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”
ayahs.tr: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal laiyinal la allahoo yatazakkkaru 'aw yakhshaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ
ayahs.en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress
ayahs.e2: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”
ayahs.tr: Qaalaa Rabbanaaa innanaa nakhaafu ai yafruta 'alainaaa aw ai yatghaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see
ayahs.e2: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing
ayahs.tr: Qaala laa takhaafaaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa araa

ayahs.ar: فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance
ayahs.e2: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance
ayahs.tr: Faatiyaahu faqoolaaa innaa Rasoolaa Rabbika fa arsil ma'anaa Banee Israaa'eela wa laa tu'azzibhum qad ji'naaka bi Aayatim mir Rabbika wassa laamu 'alaa manit taba'al hudaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away
ayahs.e2: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”
ayahs.tr: Innaa qad oohiya ilainaaa annnal 'azaaba 'alaa man kaz zaba wa tawalla

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses
ayahs.e2: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala famar Rabbu kumaa yaa Moosa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]
ayahs.e2: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbunal lazeee a'taa kulla shai'in khalqahoo summa hadaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations
ayahs.e2: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala famaa baalul quroonil oolaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبࣲۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets
ayahs.e2: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda Rabee fee kitaab, laa yadillu Rabbee wa laa yansaa

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدࣰ ا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلࣰ ا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّن نَّبَاتࣲ شَتَّىٰ
ayahs.en: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow
ayahs.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw wa salaka lakum feehaa subulanw wa anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa akhrajnaa biheee azwaajam min nabaatin shatta

ayahs.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.en: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence
ayahs.e2: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment
ayahs.tr: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulin nuhaa

ayahs.ar: ۞مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
ayahs.en: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time
ayahs.e2: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again
ayahs.tr: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wa feehaa nu'eedukum wa minhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
ayahs.en: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused
ayahs.e2: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad arainaahu Aayaatinaa kullahaa fakaz zaba wa abaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses
ayahs.e2: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses
ayahs.tr: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhri janaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaa Moosa

ayahs.ar: فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرࣲ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدࣰ ا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانࣰ ا سُوࣰ ى
ayahs.en: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned
ayahs.e2: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”
ayahs.tr: Falanaatiyannaka bisihrim mislihee faj'al bainanaa wa bainaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu wa laaa anta makaanan suwaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحࣰ ى
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning
ayahs.e2: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz zeenati wa ai yuhsharan naasu duhaa

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.en: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses]
ayahs.e2: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned
ayahs.tr: Fatawallaa Fir'awnu fajjama'a kaidahoo summa ataa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبࣰ ا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابࣲۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ
ayahs.en: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]
ayahs.e2: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala lahum Moosaa wailakum laa taftaroo 'alal laahi kaziban fa yus hitakum bi 'azaab, wa qad khaaba manif taraa

ayahs.ar: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ
ayahs.en: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation
ayahs.e2: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately
ayahs.tr: Fatanaaza'ooo amrahum bainahum wa asarrun najwaa

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way
ayahs.e2: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions
ayahs.tr: Qaalooo in haaazaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ai yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wa yazhabaa bitareeqatikumul muslaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفࣰّ اۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.en: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes
ayahs.e2: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”
ayahs.tr: Fa ajmi'oo kaidakum summma'too saffaa; wa qad aflahal yawma manis ta'laa

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ
ayahs.en: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw
ayahs.e2: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo yaa Moosaaa immaaa an tulqiya wa immaaa an nakoona awala man alqaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ
ayahs.en: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes]
ayahs.e2: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering
ayahs.tr: Qaala bal alqoo fa izaa hibaaluhum wa 'isiyyuhum yuhaiyalu ilaihi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa

ayahs.ar: فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةࣰ مُّوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses
ayahs.e2: So Moses concealed fear within himself
ayahs.tr: Fa awjasa fee nafsihee kheefatam Moosa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
ayahs.en: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior
ayahs.e2: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail
ayahs.tr: Qulnaa laa takhaf innaka antal a'laa

ayahs.ar: وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرࣲۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.en: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is
ayahs.e2: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”
ayahs.tr: Wa alqi maa fee yamee nika talqaf maa sana'oo; innamaa sana'oo kaidu saahir; wa laa yuflihus saahiru haisu ataa

ayahs.ar: فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدࣰ ا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses
ayahs.e2: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
ayahs.tr: Fa ulqiyas saharatu sujjadan qaalooo aamannaa bi Rabbi Haaroona wa Moosa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابࣰ ا وَأَبۡقَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring
ayahs.e2: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum; innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'allama kumus sihra fala uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibannakum fee juzoo'in nakhli wa lata'lamunna aiyunaaa ashaddu 'azaabanw wa abqaa

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ لَن نُّؤۡثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلۡبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنَاۖ فَٱقۡضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍۖ إِنَّمَا تَقۡضِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَآ
ayahs.en: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life
ayahs.e2: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo lan nu'siraka 'alaa maa jaaa'anaa minal baiyinaati wallazee fataranaa faqdi maaa anta qaad; innamaa taqdee haazihil hayaatad dunyaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغۡفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكۡرَهۡتَنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحۡرِۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring
ayahs.e2: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”
ayahs.tr: Innaaa aamannaa bi Rabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wa maaa akrahtanaa 'alaihi minas sihr; wallaahu khairunw waabqaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأۡتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجۡرِمࣰ ا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحۡيَىٰ
ayahs.en: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live
ayahs.e2: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die
ayahs.tr: Innahoo mai yaati Rabbahoo mujriman fa inna lahoo Jahannama laa yamotu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَأۡتِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا قَدۡ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلۡعُلَىٰ
ayahs.en: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]
ayahs.e2: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks
ayahs.tr: Wa mai yaatihee mu'minan qad 'amilas saalihaati fa ulaaa'ika lahumud dara jaatul 'ulaa

ayahs.ar: جَنَّٰتُ عَدۡنࣲ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.en: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself
ayahs.e2: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves
ayahs.tr: Jannaatu 'Adnin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa; wa zaalika jazaaa'ua man tazakka

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنۡ أَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي فَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ طَرِيقࣰ ا فِي ٱلۡبَحۡرِ يَبَسࣰ ا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكࣰ ا وَلَا تَخۡشَىٰ
ayahs.en: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]
ayahs.e2: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad awhainaaa ilaa Moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakanw wa laa takhshaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمۡ
ayahs.en: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them
ayahs.e2: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them
ayahs.tr: Fa atba'ahum Fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal yammmi maa ghashi yahum

ayahs.ar: وَأَضَلَّ فِرۡعَوۡنُ قَوۡمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them]
ayahs.e2: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺
ayahs.tr: wa adalla fir'awnu qawmahoo wa maa hadaa

ayahs.ar: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدۡ أَنجَيۡنَٰكُم مِّنۡ عَدُوِّكُمۡ وَوَٰعَدۡنَٰكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلۡأَيۡمَنَ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلۡوَىٰ
ayahs.en: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails
ayahs.e2: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails
ayahs.tr: Yaa Baneee Israaa'eela qad anjainaakum min 'aduw wikum wa wa'adnaakum jaanibat Tooril aimana wa nazzalnaa 'alaikumul Manna was Salwaa

ayahs.ar: كُلُواْ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَلَا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبِيۖ وَمَن يَحۡلِلۡ عَلَيۡهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدۡ هَوَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen
ayahs.e2: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed
ayahs.tr: Kuloo min taiyibaati maa razaqnaakum wa laa tatghaw feehi fa yahilla 'alaikum ghadabee wa mai yahlil 'alaihi ghadabee faqad hawaa

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارࣱ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحࣰ ا ثُمَّ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance
ayahs.e2: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”
ayahs.tr: Wa innee la Ghaffaarul liman taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan summah tadaa

ayahs.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَعۡجَلَكَ عَن قَوۡمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”
ayahs.tr: Wa maaa a'jalaka 'an qawmika yaa Moosa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هُمۡ أُوْلَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلۡتُ إِلَيۡكَ رَبِّ لِتَرۡضَىٰ
ayahs.en: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased
ayahs.e2: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala hum ulaaa'i 'alaaa asaree wa 'ajiltu ilaika Rabbi litardaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَوۡمَكَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray
ayahs.e2: Allah responded, “We have indeed tested your people in your absence, and the Sâmiri has led them astray.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala fa innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika wa adallahumus Saamiriyy

ayahs.ar: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ غَضۡبَٰنَ أَسِفࣰ اۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ أَلَمۡ يَعِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًاۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيۡكُمُ ٱلۡعَهۡدُ أَمۡ أَرَدتُّمۡ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيۡكُمۡ غَضَبࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ فَأَخۡلَفۡتُم مَّوۡعِدِي
ayahs.en: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me
ayahs.e2: So Moses returned to his people, furious and sorrowful. He said, “O my people! Had your Lord not made you a good promise? Has my absence been too long for you? Or have you wished for wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me?”
ayahs.tr: Faraja's Moosaaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa; qaala yaa qawmi alam ya'idkum Rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa; afataala 'alaikumul 'ahdu am arattum ai yahilla 'alaikum ghadabum mir Rabbikum fa akhlaftum maw'idee

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَخۡلَفۡنَا مَوۡعِدَكَ بِمَلۡكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلۡنَآ أَوۡزَارࣰ ا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ فَقَذَفۡنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّامِرِيُّ
ayahs.en: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw
ayahs.e2: They argued, “We did not break our promise to you of our own free will, but we were made to carry the burden of the people’s ˹golden˺ jewellery, then we threw it ˹into the fire˺, and so did the Sâmiri.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo maaa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinna wa laakinna hummilnaaa awzaaram min zeenatil qawmi faqazafnaahaa fakazaalika alqas Saamiriyy

ayahs.ar: فَأَخۡرَجَ لَهُمۡ عِجۡلࣰ ا جَسَدࣰ ا لَّهُۥ خُوَارࣱ فَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ
ayahs.en: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot
ayahs.e2: Then he moulded for them an idol of a calf that made a lowing sound. They said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but Moses forgot ˹where it was˺!”
ayahs.tr: Fa akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haazaaa ilaahukum wa ilaahu Moosaa fanasee

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَلَّا يَرۡجِعُ إِلَيۡهِمۡ قَوۡلࣰ ا وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ ضَرࣰّ ا وَلَا نَفۡعࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit
ayahs.e2: Did they not see that it did not respond to them, nor could it protect or benefit them
ayahs.tr: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilaihim qawlanw wa laa yamliku lahum darranw wa laa naf'aa

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ قَالَ لَهُمۡ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبۡلُ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوٓاْ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.en: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order
ayahs.e2: Aaron had already warned them beforehand, “O my people! You are only being tested by this, for indeed your ˹one true˺ Lord is the Most Compassionate. So follow me and obey my orders.”
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad qaala lahum Haaroonu min qablu yaa qawmi innamaa futintum bihee wa inna Rabbakumur Rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa atee'ooo amree

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.en: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us
ayahs.e2: They replied, “We will not cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alaihi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilainaa Moosaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray
ayahs.e2: Moses scolded ˹his brother˺, “O Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray
ayahs.tr: Qaala Yaa Haaroonu maa mana 'aka iz ra aitahum dallooo

ayahs.ar: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي
ayahs.en: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order
ayahs.e2: from following after me? How could you disobey my orders?”
ayahs.tr: Allaa tattabi'ani afa'asaita amree

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَبۡنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأۡخُذۡ بِلِحۡيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأۡسِيٓۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقۡتَ بَيۡنَ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمۡ تَرۡقُبۡ قَوۡلِي
ayahs.en: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word
ayahs.e2: Aaron pleaded, “O son of my mother! Do not seize me by my beard or ˹the hair of˺ my head. I really feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not observe my word.’”
ayahs.tr: Qaala yabna'umma laa taakhuz bilihyatee wa laa biraasee innee khashetu an taqoola farraqta baina Baneee Israaa'eela wa lam tarqub qawlee

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطۡبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِيُّ
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri
ayahs.e2: Moses then asked, “What did you think you were doing, O Sâmiri?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala famaa khatbuka yaa Saamiriyy

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَصُرۡتُ بِمَا لَمۡ يَبۡصُرُواْ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضۡتُ قَبۡضَةࣰ مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذۡتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتۡ لِي نَفۡسِي
ayahs.en: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me
ayahs.e2: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful ˹of dust˺ from the hoof-prints of ˹the horse of˺ the messenger-angel ˹Gabriel˺ then cast it ˹on the moulded calf˺. This is what my lower-self tempted me into.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min asarir Rasooli fanabaztuhaa wa kazaalika sawwalat lee nafsee

ayahs.ar: قَالَ فَٱذۡهَبۡ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوۡعِدࣰ ا لَّن تُخۡلَفَهُۥۖ وَٱنظُرۡ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِي ظَلۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ عَاكِفࣰ اۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ نَسۡفًا
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast
ayahs.e2: Moses said, “Go away then! And for ˹the rest of your˺ life you will surely be crying, ‘Do not touch ˹me˺!’ Then you will certainly have a fate that you cannot escape. Now look at your god to which you have been devoted: we will burn it up, then scatter it in the sea completely.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala fazhab fa inna laka fil hayaati an taqoola laa misaasa wa inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafahoo wanzur ilaaa ilaahikal lazee zalta 'alaihi 'aakifaa; lanuharriqannnahoo summa lanansifanahoo fil yammi nasfaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge
ayahs.e2: ˹Then Moses addressed his people,˺ “Your only god is Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He encompasses everything in ˹His˺ knowledge.”
ayahs.tr: Innamaaa ilaahukkumul laahul lazee laa ilaaha illaa Hoo; wasi'a kulla shai'in ilmaa

ayahs.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدۡ سَبَقَۚ وَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an
ayahs.e2: This is how We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ some of the stories of the past. And We have certainly granted you a Reminder from Us
ayahs.tr: Kazaalika naqussu 'alaika min ambaaa'i maa qad sabaq; wa qad aatainaaka mil ladunnaa Zikraa

ayahs.ar: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا
ayahs.en: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden
ayahs.e2: Whoever turns away from it will surely bear the burden ˹of sin˺ on the Day of Judgment
ayahs.tr: Man a'rada 'anhu, fa innahoo yahmilu Yawmal Qiyaamati wizraa

ayahs.ar: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ حِمۡلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load
ayahs.e2: suffering its consequences forever. What an evil burden they will carry on Judgment Day
ayahs.tr: Khaalideena feehi wa saaa'a lahum Yawmal Qiyaamati himlaa

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ زُرۡقࣰ ا
ayahs.en: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed
ayahs.e2: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather the wicked on that Day blue-faced ˹from horror and thirst˺
ayahs.tr: Yawma yunfakhu fissoori wa nahshurul mujrimeena Yawma 'izin zurqaa

ayahs.ar: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا عَشۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]
ayahs.e2: They will whisper among themselves, “You stayed no more than ten days ˹on the earth˺.”
ayahs.tr: Yatakhaafatoona bainahum il labistum illaa 'ashraa

ayahs.ar: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذۡ يَقُولُ أَمۡثَلُهُمۡ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا يَوۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day
ayahs.e2: We know best what they will say—the most reasonable of them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”
ayahs.tr: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona iz yaqoolu amsaluhum tareeqatan illabistum illaa yawmaa

ayahs.ar: وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلۡجِبَالِ فَقُلۡ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسۡفࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast
ayahs.e2: And ˹if˺ they ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the mountains, ˹then˺ say, “My Lord will wipe them out completely
ayahs.tr: Wa yas'aloonaka 'anil jibaali faqul yansifuhaa Rabbee nasfaa

ayahs.ar: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعࣰ ا صَفۡصَفࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And He will leave the earth a level plain
ayahs.e2: leaving the earth level and bare
ayahs.tr: Fa yazaruhaa qaa'an safsafaa

ayahs.ar: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجࣰ ا وَلَآ أَمۡتࣰ ا
ayahs.en: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation
ayahs.e2: with neither depressions nor elevations to be seen.”
ayahs.tr: Laa taraa feehaa 'iwajanw wa laaa amtaa

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps]
ayahs.e2: On that Day all will follow the caller ˹for assembly˺, ˹and˺ none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed before the Most Compassionate. Only whispers will be heard
ayahs.tr: Yawma iziny yattabi'oonad daa'iya laa 'iwaja lahoo wa khasha'atil aswaatu lir Rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنۡ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُۥ قَوۡلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word
ayahs.e2: On that Day no intercession will be of any benefit, except by those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are agreeable to Him
ayahs.tr: Yawma 'izil laa tanfa'ush shafaa'atu illaa man azina lahur Rahmaanu wa radiya lahoo qawlaa

ayahs.ar: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge
ayahs.e2: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them, but they cannot encompass Him in ˹their˺ knowledge
ayahs.tr: Ya'lamu maa bainaa aideehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yauheetoona bihee 'ilmaa

ayahs.ar: ۞وَعَنَتِ ٱلۡوُجُوهُ لِلۡحَيِّ ٱلۡقَيُّومِۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنۡ حَمَلَ ظُلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice
ayahs.e2: And all faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. And those burdened with wrongdoing will be in loss
ayahs.tr: Wa 'anatil wujoohu lil Haiiyil Qaiyoomi wa qad khaaba man hamala zulmaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمࣰ ا وَلَا هَضۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation
ayahs.e2: But whoever does good and is a believer will have no fear of being wronged or denied ˹their reward˺
ayahs.tr: Wa mai ya'mal minas saalihaati wa huwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmanw wa laa hadmaa

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيࣰّ ا وَصَرَّفۡنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَّقُونَ أَوۡ يُحۡدِثُ لَهُمۡ ذِكۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance
ayahs.e2: And so We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and varied the warnings in it, so perhaps they will shun evil or it may cause them to be mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa kazaalika anzalnaahu Qur-aanan 'Arabiyyanw wa sarrafnaa fee hi minal wa'eedi la'allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdisu lahum zikraa

ayahs.ar: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge
ayahs.e2: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Do not rush to recite ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran ˹O Prophet˺ before it is ˹properly˺ conveyed to you, and pray, “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”
ayahs.tr: Fata'aalal laahul Malikul Haqq; wa laa ta'jal bil Quraani min qabli ai yuqdaaa ilaika wahyuhoo wa qur Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ عَهِدۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبۡلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمۡ نَجِدۡ لَهُۥ عَزۡمࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination
ayahs.e2: And indeed, We once made a covenant with Adam, but he forgot, and ˹so˺ We did not find determination in him
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad 'ahidnaaa ilaaa Aadama min qablu fanasiya wa lam najid lahoo 'azmaa

ayahs.ar: وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسۡجُدُواْ لِأٓدَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
ayahs.en: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused
ayahs.e2: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who refused ˹arrogantly˺
ayahs.tr: Wa iz qulnaa lilma laaa'ikatis judoo li Aadama fasajadooo illaaa Iblees; abaa

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوࣱّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوۡجِكَ فَلَا يُخۡرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ فَتَشۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer
ayahs.e2: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺
ayahs.tr: Faqulnaa yaaa Aadamu inna haazaa 'aduwwul laka wa lizawjika falaa yukhrijan nakumaa minal Jannati fatashqaa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعۡرَىٰ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed
ayahs.e2: Here it is guaranteed that you will never go hungry or unclothed
ayahs.tr: Innaa laka allaa tajoo'a feeha wa laa ta'raa

ayahs.ar: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظۡمَؤُاْ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضۡحَىٰ
ayahs.en: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun
ayahs.e2: nor will you ˹ever˺ suffer from thirst or ˹the sun’s˺ heat.”
ayahs.tr: Wa annaka laa tazma'u feehaa wa laa tadhaa

ayahs.ar: فَوَسۡوَسَ إِلَيۡهِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ وَمُلۡكࣲ لَّا يَبۡلَىٰ
ayahs.en: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate
ayahs.e2: But Satan whispered to him, saying, “O Adam! Shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that does not fade away?”
ayahs.tr: Fa waswasa ilaihish Shaitaanu qaala yaaa Aadamu hal adulluka 'alaa shajaratil khuldi wa mulkil laa yablaa

ayahs.ar: فَأَكَلَا مِنۡهَا فَبَدَتۡ لَهُمَا سَوۡءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخۡصِفَانِ عَلَيۡهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
ayahs.en: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred
ayahs.e2: So they both ate from the tree and then their nakedness was exposed to them, prompting them to cover themselves with leaves from Paradise. So Adam disobeyed his Lord, and ˹so˺ lost his way
ayahs.tr: Fa akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw aatuhumaa wa tafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alaihimaa minw waraqil jannah; wa 'asaaa Aadamu Rabbahoo faghawaa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ٱجۡتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡهِ وَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him]
ayahs.e2: Then his Lord chose him ˹for His grace˺, accepted his repentance, and guided him ˹rightly˺
ayahs.tr: Summaj tabbahu Rabbuhoo fataaba 'alaihi wa hadaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ٱهۡبِطَا مِنۡهَا جَمِيعَۢاۖ بَعۡضُكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوࣱّۖ فَإِمَّا يَأۡتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدࣰ ى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشۡقَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter]
ayahs.e2: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺
ayahs.tr: Qaalah bita minhaa jamee'am ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww; fa immaa yaati yannakum minnee hudan famanit taba'a hudaaya falaa yadillu wa laa yashhqaa

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَن ذِكۡرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةࣰ ضَنكࣰ ا وَنَحۡشُرُهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ أَعۡمَىٰ
ayahs.en: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind
ayahs.e2: But whoever turns away from My Reminder will certainly have a miserable life, then We will raise them up blind on the Day of Judgment.”
ayahs.tr: Wa man a'rada 'an Zikree fa inna lahoo ma'eeshatan dankanw wa nahshuruhoo Yawmal Qiyaamati a'maa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing
ayahs.e2: They will cry, “My Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, although I used to see?”
ayahs.tr: Qaala Rabbi lima hashar tanee a'maa wa qad kuntu baseeraa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتۡكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَاۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُنسَىٰ
ayahs.en: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten
ayahs.e2: Allah will respond, “It is so, just as Our revelations came to you and you neglected them, so Today you are neglected.”
ayahs.tr: Qaala kazaalika atatka Aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa wa kazaalikal Yawma tunsaa

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَنۡ أَسۡرَفَ وَلَمۡ يُؤۡمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبۡقَىٰٓ
ayahs.en: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring
ayahs.e2: This is how We reward whoever transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of their Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting
ayahs.tr: Wa kazaalika najzee man asrafa wa lam yu'mim bi Aayaati Rabbih; wa la'azaabul Aakhirati ashaddu wa abqaa

ayahs.ar: أَفَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.en: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence
ayahs.e2: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment
ayahs.tr: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil li ulinnuhaa

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةࣱ سَبَقَتۡ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامࣰ ا وَأَجَلࣱ مُّسَمࣰّ ى
ayahs.en: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed]
ayahs.e2: Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ and a term already set, their ˹instant˺ doom would have been inevitable
ayahs.tr: Wa law laa Kalimatun sabaqat mir Rabbika lakaana lizaamanw wa ajalum musammaa

ayahs.ar: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ
ayahs.en: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied
ayahs.e2: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺
ayahs.tr: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi Rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qabla ghuroobihaa wa min aanaaa'il laili fasbbih wa atraafan nahaari la 'allaka tardaa

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لِنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيهِۚ وَرِزۡقُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرࣱ وَأَبۡقَىٰ
ayahs.en: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring
ayahs.e2: Do not let your eyes crave what We have allowed some of the disbelievers to enjoy; the ˹fleeting˺ splendour of this worldly life, which We test them with. But your Lord’s provision ˹in the Hereafter˺ is far better and more lasting
ayahs.tr: Wa laa tamuddanna 'ainaika ilaa ma matta'na biheee azwajam minhum zahratal hayaatid dunya linaftinahum feeh; wa rizqu Rabbika khairunw wa abqaa

ayahs.ar: وَأۡمُرۡ أَهۡلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ عَلَيۡهَاۖ لَا نَسۡـَٔلُكَ رِزۡقࣰ اۖ نَّحۡنُ نَرۡزُقُكَۗ وَٱلۡعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰ
ayahs.en: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness
ayahs.e2: Bid your people to pray, and be diligent in ˹observing˺ it. We do not ask you to provide. It is We Who provide for you. And the ultimate outcome is ˹only˺ for ˹the people of˺ righteousness
ayahs.tr: Waamur ahlaka bis Salaati wastabir 'alaihaa la nas'aluka rizqaa; nahnu narzuquk; wal 'aaqibatu littaqwaa

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا يَأۡتِينَا بِـَٔايَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓۚ أَوَلَمۡ تَأۡتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
ayahs.en: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures
ayahs.e2: They demand, “If only he could bring us a sign from his Lord!” Have they not ˹already˺ received a confirmation of what is in earlier Scriptures
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo law laa yaateenaa bi Aayatim mmir Rabbih; awalam taatihim baiyinatu maa fis suhufil oolaa

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ أَنَّآ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُم بِعَذَابࣲ مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَآ أَرۡسَلۡتَ إِلَيۡنَا رَسُولࣰ ا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخۡزَىٰ
ayahs.en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced
ayahs.e2: Had We destroyed them with a torment before this ˹Prophet came˺, they would have surely argued, “Our Lord! If only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before being humiliated and put to shame.”
ayahs.tr: Wa law annaaa ahlaknaahum bi'azaabim min qablihee laqaaloo Rabbanaa law laaa arsalta ilainaa Rasoolan fanattabi's Aayaatika min qabli an nazilla wa nakhzaa

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ كُلࣱّ مُّتَرَبِّصࣱ فَتَرَبَّصُواْۖ فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
ayahs.en: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided
ayahs.e2: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Each ˹of us˺ is waiting, so keep waiting! You will soon know who is on the Straight Path and is ˹rightly˺ guided.”
ayahs.tr: Qul kullum mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasta'lamoona man Ashaabus Siraatis Sawiyyi wa manih tadaa
